answer: The delta schedule is applied in opal and beacon reveals each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and thus 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3285 identities would post 4473 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
